hypothesis: A reference-tracking signal and PLR each improve frozen-policy robustness relative to the legacy actuator-following signal and native sampler; their interaction is estimated rather than assumed additive.
maxrl_exclusion: MaxRL is not used: its clean estimator requires grouped repeated rollouts with binary terminal correctness, while this task trains PPO on dense continuous tracking rewards.

plr.score: mean absolute native unnormalised GAE (L1 value loss)
plr.duplicate_rule: one mass per global level, split over resident copies
plr.sampling_event_clock: motion draws detected by terminal, episode-start-bin change, or non-increasing motion elapsed step in deterministic time-then-env order
plr.score_attribution: native rollout GAE attributed to the episode-start bin
plr.runtime_scope: single process; multi-process launch fails closed

signal.legacy: PD joint_pos_target -> executed joint_pos latent cosine gap
signal.tracking: reference joint_pos -> executed joint_pos latent cosine gap
tracking_treatment_bundle: explicit body-joint mapping and soft-limit normalization for raw features
fixed maximum-gap marks for non-timeout early termination
signal.controller_signal: frozen-encoder reference->execution latent gap; the diagnostic feature vector is not fitted into a utility estimator
diagnostics: causal best lag, aligned residual, and lag-explained fraction
reference motion amplitude and total-error-to-motion ratio

decision_rule: Report all four paired contrasts on both ladders. Directional language requires across-training-seed agreement; per-episode intervals are precision only. A non-converged arm is labelled an equal-budget lower bound.
not_yet_verified: all mechanics and outcomes; written before launch
